task.pr_title: fix(mobile): Fix for incorrectly naming edited files and structure change

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: A filename like `this.is.my.image.jpg` will become `this_edited.jpg` right? Maybe the `path` package can be used here

evidence.thread_resolution:
Yuvi-raj-P: Hi, so I just realized after someone told me that the file for a since my past commit was being incorrectly saved. The file was saving as null_edited. I used the asset's file name but somehow the asset was null all the time, so to fix that small issue I had to completely change the code and structure of the edit page.
michelheusschen: A filename with dots is still saved incorrectly. I tested it, and `this.is.my.image.jpg` gets renamed to `this_edited.jpg`. You could do this to fix that:

```dart
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;

title: "${p.withoutExtension(asset.fileName)}_edited.jpg"
```
Yuvi-raj-P: Dang that is very clever of you, I never though I would see a name with dots so I casually did that lol. Thanks! 😅
